					<h3>Basic kite course in Tarifa</h3>
            <p><strong>One day kitesurf course</strong> is ideal if you do not know if kitesurfing is a sport for you. <strong>First day</strong> you will learn <strong>how to fly a kite</strong>,  prepare your equipment, safety systems and correct choice of spot to practice depending on wind and other factors. The basic idea of this course is that when you finish, you know how to choose the right place at the beach, prepare your stuff and be able to fly the kite. The goal of the first day of your <strong>kite course is to be fully ready to go to the water</strong> the next day!  </p>

				  <h2><a href="https://kitefuntarifa.com/en/" style="color:#41cb3a">2 days kitesurf course in Tarifa</a></h2>
					<h3>Intermediate kite course in Tarifa</h3>
            <p><strong>Two days kitesurf course</strong> is ideal if you only have a weekend to escape to Tarifa. On the first day you will make the planned program (take a look above) and on the 2nd day you will have your <strong>first contact with the water</strong> to learn something fundamental, <strong>the bodydrag.</strong> The goal is to be ready to start the Water-start (board) your next following lesson!    </p>
           <br/>
		
						<h4 style="color:#41cb3a"><strong>You will learn to:</strong></h4>
				  <p>You'll learn Day 1 and begin with bodydrag. Bodydrag is <strong>drag the body in the water with the power of your kite.</strong> You will learn to go in different directions and also rescue your board. You will also learn to <strong>relaunch the kite</strong> from the water and how to generate power to be ready for the board.  </p>

				  <h2><a href="https://kitefuntarifa.com/en/" style="color:#41cb3a">3 days kitesurf course in Tarifa</a></h2>
					<h3>Advanced kitesurf course in Tarifa</h3>
            <p>  A <strong>3 days kite course</strong> is the most recommended to have a basic understanding of all aspects of kitesurf. During day 1 and day 2 of your course you will perform the programs described above and on the third day learn the <strong>Water-start</strong>, which is to put the board on the feet, get up and <strong>ride your first meters.</strong>   </p>
           <br/>
		
						<h4 style="color:#41cb3a"><strong>You will learn to:</strong></h4>
				  <p>Day 1 and day 2. On day three begin with <strong>waterstart.</strong> The order of learning will be: First, put the board on the feet; Second, maintain the correct position of both kite and body. Third, you will learn the handling of the kite and find the point of power needed to get up safely. Finally, we will work on the position of your body and board and get you to <strong>make your first meters over the board!</strong> Depending on the length of your course, you will have time to advance further through all the aspects described.  </p>

				  <h2><a href="https://kitefuntarifa.com/en/" style="color:#41cb3a">5 days kitesurf course in Tarifa</a></h2>
				<h3>"From Zero to Hero" kitesurf course in Tarifa</h3>
            <p> The <strong>5-day kite course</strong> is recommended for those who want to have a <strong>complete idea about kitesurfing.</strong> During day 1, day 2 and day 3, you will learn everything you need to make <strong>your first meters on the board.</strong> On day 4 and day 5 of your course, with a bit of practice, you'll be able to get up and ride in both directions and also kite upwind. <strong>Our goal is that you get to be a totally independent kitesurfer! :-)</strong>     </p>
           <br/>
		
						<h4 style="color:#41cb3a"><strong>You will learn to:</strong></h4>
				  <p>You will learn day 1, day 2 and day 3. Finally, in this 4th and 5th day, you will not only make your first meters on the board, but you will able to <strong>kite with confidence</strong> in both directions, <strong>ride up-wind</strong> (which is to be able to go and come back to the same place without problems). And who knows, if you're very good, maybe your first jumps! </p>

 <div class="faq">
<h2 style="color:#41cb3a">Group Kitesurf Courses in Tarifa – FAQ</h2>

  <details>
    <summary>What is included in a group kitesurf course in Tarifa?</summary>
    <p>The group kitesurf course in Tarifa includes a certified instructor, full kitesurf equipment, radio helmets for real-time communication, liability and accident insurance, and full assistance during the entire kitesurf lesson.</p>
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Why choose a group kitesurf course in Tarifa?</summary>
    <p>Group kitesurf lessons in Tarifa offer a dynamic, fun and motivating learning environment. You learn kitesurfing with friends while benefiting from a great balance between price, quality and professional instruction.</p>
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Do I need experience for group kitesurf lessons in Tarifa?</summary>
    <p>No previous experience is required. Our group kitesurf courses in Tarifa are designed for beginners and intermediate riders who want to improve their kitesurf technique. Groups are organized by similar level for faster progress.</p>
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>How many hours does it take to learn kitesurfing in Tarifa?</summary>
    <p>Most students learn basic kite control and start riding after 4–5 hours of kitesurf training in Tarifa. However, progression depends on each student and consistent practice is essential.</p>
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>What equipment do we use in our kitesurf school in Tarifa?</summary>
    <p>We use premium kitesurf gear from leading brands such as North Kiteboarding, Ocean Rodeo and Mystic. Equipment is regularly updated to ensure safety, performance and faster learning progress.</p>
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Is equipment shared during group kitesurf lessons?</summary>
    <p>Depending on group size and conditions, some equipment may be shared during exercises. Lessons are always organized to maximize water time and individual progression.</p>
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Is it safe to learn kitesurfing in Tarifa in a group?</summary>
    <p>Yes. Group kitesurf courses in Tarifa are safe thanks to modern equipment, radio communication systems and structured safety protocols adapted to each level.</p>
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>When is the best time for group kitesurf courses in Tarifa?</summary>
    <p>Tarifa is one of the best kitesurf destinations in Europe, with consistent wind conditions most of the year. Group kitesurf courses run throughout different seasons depending on weather conditions.</p>
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>How many students are in each group kitesurf course?</summary>
    <p>We keep small group sizes to ensure personalized attention. Depending on conditions, groups can range from 2 students sharing one kite to small groups of 3–4 students with limited equipment rotation.</p>
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Can I book a multi-day group kitesurf course in Tarifa?</summary>
    <p>Yes. We offer multi-day group kitesurf courses in Tarifa adapted to your level, availability and learning goals.</p>
  </details>

</div>
